entries.caption: A flatcar carrying a load of white panels wrapped in a red and black branded cover, passing a lake with a mountain in the background.
A white BNSF boxcar displays a large, stylized pictorial piece with maroon and green shapes. The car is a BNSF boxcar.
A flatcar loaded with stacks of white panels wrapped in a red and black branded cover, moving past a lake with a mountain in the distance.

A BNSF hopper car with number 49035, featuring a large, colorful mural-style graffiti piece in blue, yellow, and red with the word 'LIZON' in bold block letters. The train continues past a lake with a tree-lined shore and a snow-capped mountain under a clear sky.

A black tank car with yellow safety panels and the markings PPRX 171202 is passing by on a track beside a lake; a large, stylized graffiti piece in white and yellow reads 'GABELOVESALEX' across the side of the car.

A BNSF hopper car with number 472906, displaying a large, colorful mural-style graffiti piece in blue, yellow, and red with the word 'LIZON' in bold block letters. The train passes a scenic view of a lake, trees, and a forested hill under a bright sky.

A maroon BNSF hopper car, number 478233, with a large white and black graffiti piece that reads 'BULLE' in a stylized blockbuster font. The piece is centered on the car's side. The car also has a white circular Santa Fe Railway logo. It is passing a lake with a tree in the foreground.

A maroon BNSF hopper car with the number 491607, featuring a large green and white graffiti piece that reads 'WE CAN'T STOP' in bold, stylized letters. The artwork is well-composed and covers a significant portion of the car's side.

A BNSF hopper car with a large, colorful mural-style graffiti piece on its side. The piece features the word 'NEYKA' in bold purple letters with a black outline, a green and blue background, and a yellow border. The BNSF logo and number 488269 are visible. The train moves past a lake with trees in the foreground.

A maroon BNSF hopper car with number 475160. The side features a large, detailed mural of a train scene with multiple locomotives and railcars. The artwork is painted in a realistic style with a mix of colors including green, blue, and white. The BNSF logo is visible above the mural.

A maroon BNSF hopper car, number 498133, featuring a large, detailed portrait of a man with dark hair and a woman with blonde hair. The artwork is a well-composed, intentional piece that covers a significant portion of the car's side. The car moves past a lake under a bright sky.

A white hopper car with number 352906, featuring a large red and yellow 'ARNO-N-HEKTIK' logo with a stylized arrow. The car has a clean, intentional design with a red outline and a yellow arrow pointing right. The train moves past a lake with trees and a distant town under a bright sky.

A CP boxcar with reporting mark CP 546291, featuring a large red and white 'M' art piece on its side. The artwork is bold and stylized, covering a significant portion of the car's surface. The train is moving along a track with a lake and trees in the background.

A BNSF hopper car with number 496077, featuring a large, bold black and white graffiti piece spelling 'HAR' in stylized block letters. The artwork is centered on the side of the maroon car. The train moves past a lake under overcast light.
A container car with two stacked containers; the top one has a large green 'Tiger Cool Express' logo. The lower container is clean. The car is moving past a tree-lined riverbank under overcast light.

A flatcar carrying OSI Lumber panels, with the red and black branding clearly visible. The car's red frame and yellow railings are in view, and the repeating pattern of the branded panels dominates the frame.

A flatcar carrying OSI Lumber panels, with the red and black branding clearly visible. The red frame and yellow railings of the car are in view, and the repeating pattern of the branded panels creates a strong visual rhythm.

A flatcar loaded with stacks of white panels branded 'OSI Lumber' in red and black text, moving through a scenic view of a lake and trees. The car's red frame and yellow safety railings are visible, and the repeating logo creates a strong graphic pattern.
A yellow boxcar features a large, detailed American flag painted on its side, with a red and white striped pattern and a blue field with stars, above a green and blue tag below.
A black intermodal container car with a large blue Amazon smile logo painted on its side; the artwork is bold and centered, making it a clear focal point.

A double-stacked intermodal container car with a black top container featuring a large blue Amazon smile logo. The container is moving quickly past a fixed camera, creating motion blur. The scene is set beside a body of water with a tree in the foreground and a distant treeline under an overcast sky.
A green boxcar with a large, bold graffiti piece spelling "PANAS" in block letters; the artwork features a grid pattern and a red "X-HOURLASS" logo in the upper right corner.
A maroon BNSF hopper car with number 473646, featuring a colorful art piece in green, blue, and red with a stylized face and abstract shapes.
A red BNSF hopper car with a large white stencil-style artwork depicting a figure and abstract shapes, moving past a lake in bright daylight.

A maroon BNSF hopper car with number 478297, featuring a large multi-color graffiti piece in yellow, green, and blue across the side. The artwork is a stylized wildstyle piece with a prominent red outline.

A maroon BNSF hopper car with the number 489436, covered in a large multi-color graffiti piece in blue, yellow, and white. The artwork includes stylized letters and a circular design. The car is moving past a lake.
A maroon BNSF hopper car with the number 496864, featuring a large black and white graffiti piece with the text 'JUDDNDA' and 'JOE KEEN'. The train moves past a lake and trees under bright daylight.
A dark boxcar continues through the frame, its side marked only by a small white rectangle. The train moves at night with a city skyline visible in the background.
A dark boxcar with a single white rectangular tag on its side, captured in motion; the tag is a simple, unadorned marking with no visible text or design.
A dark boxcar in motion, showing a faint white rectangular tag on its side; the tag is simple and unadorned, with no visible text or design.

A green hopper car with number 202634, featuring a large white graffiti piece with red accents and a stylized design on its side. The car is moving past a body of water with trees and a distant town under a bright sky.

A pink hopper car with a bold black and white graffiti piece that reads 'KONK' in a blocky, geometric style. The artwork dominates the side of the car, which is part of a freight train moving along a track beside a lake.
A boxcar with a large graffiti piece in red and black; the artwork features a stylized character or figure with bold lines and a dynamic pose, painted over the side of the car.

A boxcar with a large graffiti piece in progress; the artwork features a stylized character or figure in white and gray tones, partially obscured by motion blur, with a dark background. The car is moving through the frame from left to right.

A dark boxcar with a large, multi-color graffiti piece on its side; the artwork features a stylized face with bold red and blue outlines and a yellow fill, partially obscured by the train's motion. The car is moving through a wooded area at night.

A boxcar with a large graffiti piece in progress; the artwork features a stylized character or face in white and gray tones, with a dark background. The piece is partially visible, showing bold outlines and shading. The car's reporting mark 'BNSF' is visible in the upper left corner.

A red hopper car with a large, vibrant mural covering its side. The artwork features a complex composition with multiple colors including purple, green, blue, and white, depicting abstract shapes and figures. The piece is detailed and spans the full length of the car.
A maroon BNSF hopper car, number 479658, features a large white circular logo on its side. The train moves past a water view under overcast skies.

A maroon BNSF hopper car with the number 441760, featuring a large blue and white graffiti piece that reads 'MESS PHUX' in bold block letters. The car is moving past a lake with trees and a distant cityscape under bright daylight.

A maroon BNSF hopper car features a large, mural-scale graffiti piece with the word 'MEAD' in bold white letters outlined in black, with red accents and a circular logo on the right side; the artwork dominates the car's side.

A maroon BNSF hopper car with the number 486922, featuring a large, well-composed graffiti piece with the word 'LUSHH' in bold yellow letters and a stylized white shape. The train moves past a lake with trees and a distant town.

A weathered white ADMX hopper car with number 58081, featuring a large blue diamond logo with 'ADM' text. The car shows significant wear and rust, with a faint graffiti tag on the side. It passes a lake with trees in the background.

A weathered white ADMX hopper car with number 58081, featuring a large blue diamond logo with 'ADM' text. The car shows significant wear and rust, with a faint graffiti tag on the side. It passes a lake with trees in the background.

A boxcar with a large graffiti piece in progress: a multi-color design featuring a red and white character with a blue outline, partially obscured by a white rectangular block. The art is mid-execution, with visible spray lines and a mix of bright colors against the car's dark surface.

The same Ryder boxcar continues its passage, now showing more of its side. The red 'Ryder' logo and 'Ever better.' text are fully visible. The car is moving left to right, with a stack of concrete sleepers visible behind the track.

A white boxcar with a large red 'Ryder' logo and the tagline 'Ever better.' in black text. The logo includes a stylized black swoosh. The car is moving from left to right, partially visible at the bottom of the frame.

A red BNSF hopper car with a large, colorful graffiti piece on the side. The graffiti is a complex piece with multiple colors and shapes, including a heart and a circular design. The number 481756 is visible.
A flatcar loaded with stacked white packages featuring a blue logo, with a yellow frame. The train moves past a lake under bright daylight.
A flatcar loaded with stacked white packages featuring a blue logo, with a yellow frame. The train moves past a lake under bright daylight.
